- Spanish texts fixed,

notes.title: Polish translation available

notes.title: OST as DLC, French translation available and Windows JRE updated
notes.notes:
The original sound track by David Cañadas has been added as (free) DLC. 

French translation available (game and user's manual) thanks to Attilion.

Windows JRE has been updated to version 1.8.0_92.

notes.title: User's manual added to installation files and game over texts fixed
notes.notes:
We have updated to the game in order to add the user's manual to the installation directory. It is also possible to get it from the shop page.

Game over texts have been fixed because they were in Spanish in all versions.

Also, some texts of Italian version have been changed.
